page: Amazon Web Services c6a.32xlarge is a compute-optimized server instance powered by AMD EPYC 7R13 processors. Built on the x86_64 architecture, this instance features 128 virtual CPUs mapped to 64 dedicated physical cores with hyperthreading enabled. The processors operate at a clock speed of 3.6 GHz and include 32 KB L1d cache, 0.5 MB L2 cache, and 32 MB L3 cache. The system is equipped with 256.0 GB of DDR4 memory running at 3 GHz, yielding a memory-to-core ratio of 2.0 GB per core. It utilizes the Nitro hypervisor and provides a baseline network bandwidth of 50 Gbps. No local storage or GPU hardware is bundled with this instance.

In benchmark evaluations, the c6a.32xlarge demonstrates top-tier performance in multi-core CPU execution, ranking in the top 10% for stress-ng multi-core and PassMark CPU tests. Memory bandwidth for cached small-block reads also reaches the top 10%, while large-block read and write operations fall into the top 25%. The instance excels in cryptographic workloads, with PassMark encryption and extended instruction tests scoring in the top 10%. However, single-threaded performance is more moderate, with Geekbench single-core and text processing benchmarks placing in the middle 50%.

The instance offers high compute density and strong multi-threaded efficiency, making it qualitatively cost-effective for parallel processing workloads that do not require local NVMe storage or GPU acceleration. The lack of AVX-512 support limits its utility for certain vector-heavy scientific computations, but it remains highly capable for software compilation, ray tracing, and database operations, where it achieves strong benchmark ratings. Appropriate workloads include static web serving, Redis key-value stores, multi-threaded decompression, and CPU-based machine learning prompt processing.

It features 128 vCPUs (64 physical cores), 256.0 GB of DDR4 memory, and a 50 Gbps baseline network speed, running on the Nitro hypervisor. The instance does not include local storage or GPU accelerators. In benchmarks, the c6a.32xlarge delivers top-tier multi-core CPU performance and memory bandwidth for cached reads, alongside strong cryptographic execution. Single-threaded tasks and text processing perform in the average tier. It is suited for software compilation, ray tracing, static web serving, and database operations.
